messages:
Priya Nair: hey everyone! i'm Priya — joining as a PM on Product Growth. based in NYC. excited to dig into inference economics and meet y'all. love chai, plants, and tinkering with keyboard layouts. happy to grab 1:1s or coffee chats! :wave:
Alex Kim: welcome Priya!! :tada: coffee this week? i'm in SF but can do virtual ☕
Marco Reyes: welcome aboard Priya. we'll set up a quick sync tomorrow to go over first-week priorities. @welcome-bot can you add Priya to #product-oncall?
welcome-bot: Added Priya Nair to #product-oncall and sent onboarding checklist DM :white_check_mark:
Lila Park: hi Priya — quick question: office snack poll — donuts vs bagels? 🍩🥯
Priya Nair: donuts all the way. chai + glazed is my vibe :yum:
Sam Ortiz: donuts it is. also, our #plants channel will appreciate your photos :seedling:
Theo Alvarez: hi Priya, welcome! ping me if you want help setting up local dev envs or SDKs. i can do a 15m today.
Priya Nair: awesome, thanks Theo. i might take you up on that. small fun fact: i write tiny emacs macros to manage groceries 😅
Alex Kim: that is both terrifying and impressive 😂
Marco Reyes: added Priya to weekly product sync and onboarding calendar invites. excited to have you on the team!
Priya Nair: thanks everyone — looking forward to working with you all! :smile:
